title: La Iglesia
goal: Read how the Church functioned as the colony's real infrastructure, from early universities to self-governing Jesuit missions and an Inquisition that couldn't prosecute indigenous people.

items: Name two functions the Church performed beyond religious life.
Describe what the Jesuit 'reducciones' were and how they differed from the encomienda.
Explain what happened to the reducciones in 1767 and why.
Explain who the Inquisition did and didn't have jurisdiction over.
Use the gerund to describe two things happening at once.
